content: Ad ittwabarek SIDI, Taṣḍart inu, wenni isseřmaden ifassen inu i umenɣi, iḍewḍan inu i řḥarb.
Cek i d ayi teǧid d ameddukkeř inu i dayes tamexsiwt icewwaren, uřa d lburj inu, lburj inu yuɛřan d amsenjem inu, taseddart inu i useřqi, d wenni ɣar arekkwařeɣ, d wenni d ayi isswaḍḍɛen řgens inu.
A SIDI, min iɛna bnadem, aqa Cek texsed ad t tessned? Mmis n bnadem, aqa Cek tᵉttxarriṣed dayes?
Bnadem amecnaw řefwar, ussan nnes ad ɛdun am tiři.
Meyyeř ijenwan nnec, a SIDI, hwa-dd. Ḥada idurar, xenni ad ggen ddexxan.
Ẓaryeḍ assamen u zeǧeɛ i-ten, sekk fřitcat nnec u sxarweḍ i-ten.
Swiẓẓeḍ ifassen nnec zi sennej, suffeɣ ayi-dd u fekk ayi zi řḥemřat n waman timeqqranin, zeg ufus n ibarraniyyen,
maɣar aqemmum nsen iqqar ixarriqen, afus nsen afusi d ijj n ufus iccur s řɣecc.
A AREBBI, ad ac ɣennjeɣ ijj n yezři d n jdid i Cek, s lharpa u s lɛud s ɛecra n ifiřan ad ac zehhdeɣ.
Cek d wenni issawaḍen asenjem i ijejǧiden, d wenni ifekken amsexxar nnes Dawud zi ssif aɛeffan,
suffeɣ ayi-dd u fekk ayi zeg ufus n tarwa n ubarrani, zeg wenni ɣar iǧa uqemmum i iqqaren mɣir ixarriqen, u zeg wenni ɣar iǧa ufus afusi iccur s řɣecc.
Meɛlik iḥenjiren nneɣ ad iřin am yiɣeddiwen, inni imɣaren ɛad di temẓi nsen, yessitneɣ am tɣemmar i ggin s ukeccuḍ s ɛřam kuř arcamen, ggin tent i yict n zzawect iqeddsen.
Ad ccuren řehrit nneɣ, ad wcen zzad awarni zzad, ad yarni wuǧi nneɣ s řuřuf n tseqqar, s ɛecra n řuřuf n tseqqar di ddmani n tarewsa nneɣ.
Ad ḥemřen imwan nneɣ mliḥ, war ittiři ɛad uhjam niɣ d uffuɣ i umenɣi uřa d iɣuyyan deg wazzayen nneɣ.
Sseɛd n řgens nni iǧan amya. Sseɛd n řgens nni zi AREBBI nsen d SIDI.
